mission.title: Love and Loathing
mission.description: Pose as Crucic to get his dossier on Morpheus.

npc.say: If you need Medical Supplies, I must see a letter from the hospital Manager first.
That should cover it. If you see the hospital manager again, tell him to get an email account. I don't like relying on his letters for communication.
These pathetic fools thought they could kill me! Me of all people! Morons -- all of them! Now look at them now, they're all dead!

phase.briefing:
Crucic was planning on meeting a redpill named Chimay before we brought about the good doctor's demise. With him out of the way, you will run this little errand in his stead. The end result will provide you with Crucic's medical journal.
The first part of your assignment is to go to this doctor's office and steal some medical supplies. I don't care how you do it, just get them. Crucic was borrowing supplies from Chimay so we need some to make this transaction go smooth.

enter.say: This office has a security staff, so don't expect a silent run. They have medical supplies in several locations. Evaluate your options before you start killing doctors, okay?

talk.say:
If you need Medical Supplies, I must see a letter from the hospital Manager first.
Bring me a signed letter and the supplies are yours.

objective.text: Get a signed letter from the Hospital Manager
Give the signed letter to Tran Vandervoort

done.say: That'll do. The medical supplies are yours.

objective.text: Get the Medical Supplies from Tran Vandervoort

done.say: Those medical supplies look a little rusty. I hope Chimay bites the bait.
That should cover it. If you see the hospital manager again, tell him to get an email account. I don't like relying on his letters for communication.

phase.briefing: The medical supplies only cover the first half of your needs. You still need Crucic's business card from your last assignment. Pick the business card up from Cheeta at this address.

enter.say: Find Cheeta and get that card back. Keep an eye out for hostiles while you're at it.

objective.text: Get Crucic's Business Card from Cheeta

talk.say: It's about freaking time you showed up. Take the damn card.
That's Cheeta. Get the Business Card from him. We need the Card Key to convince a redpill from Zion that you're Crucic.

done.say: This is Crucic's business card. It's good to know that we'll put it to use this time. Crucic died for a reason, I suppose.

phase.briefing:
The medical supplies and business card will help you pose as Crucic. You must convince Chimay that you're the real deal so he'll give you Crucic's medical journal.
Find Chimay at this address and speak with him.

enter.say: Part with the business card if they need extra proof that you're Crucic. Once Chimay has his medical supplies, he should tell you a little more about Morpheus' vacation construct and give you Crucic's dossier on Morpheus.

objective.text: Give Crucic's Business Card to Thusnelda

talk.say: Excuse me... Can I help you? Are you here to see Chimay? If you are, I'll need some sort of identification.
Hmm... Give Thusnelda the business card. That will get you through.

done.say: Meet with Chimay now. He should be in the next room.

Ah, you must be the doctor that Chimay has been waiting for. Chimay is very anxious to speak with you. I'll let you through.
The door is open now.

objective.text: Give the Medical Supplies to Chimay

talk.say:
You must be Doctor Crucic. It's good to finally meet you -- even if it is inside the Matrix. Things have been a little different with Niobe stepping up at Zion.
So... can I get my medical supplies from you? You can have your Medical Journal back. What do you say?
Give me the supplies and the journal is back in your hands.
So it seems Chimay is willing to part with Crucic's medical journal without violence. I'm almost... disappointed. Get Crucic's dossier from Chimay now.

done.say: Thanks for my medical supplies, Crucic. You can have your medical journal back and the dossier as well.
It appears that Crucic's dossier is included as well. You may keep the medical journal. It's the dossier I want.

I hope it's okay that I read some pages in your medical journal. Research, you know?
I heard about the simulacra of Niobe for Morpheus' sex surrogate, but I didn't know she entered the construct herself and had physical -- well, digital -- contact with Morpheus. Very interesting...

objective.text: Get Crucic's Medical Journal from Chimay

phase.briefing:
You're free to keep Crucic's medical journal. I've already pulled all the information I need from it.
We need Crucic's dossier secured. Meet up with Cheeta once more and give the dossier to him.

talk.say:
You're back? Slaughtered some Zion reddies I take it?
I need the Dossier. The Merovingian doesn't want us losing valuable intel.

mission.finish:
According to Crucic's medical journal, Morpheus almost "lost it" at one point. It's humorous -- Morpheus losing his mind... It got so bad that he needed to live in some farcical fantasy construct re-living his love affair with Lock's girlfriend, Niobe. Hmm, it makes sense now, doesn't it? Morpheus' on-going love for Niobe brought on Lock's jealousy. It festered and grew into pure loathing for Morpheus. Couple this with the fact that Morpheus was meddling with the Truce and it all becomes obvious.
Don't you see it? Lock hired someone to kill Morpheus... No wonder the Zion redpills are ambushing you in the streets: they are trying to cover up the truth about Lock and Morpheus.
